benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 installments of Rs 2,000 directly to bank account.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families (small and marginal). Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payers, and government employees.
howToApply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centre (CSC). Documents: Aadhaar, bank account, land records. Status check at PM-KISAN portal.
coverage: Over 11 crore farmers enrolled. Amount credited to Aadhaar-linked bank account.

benefit: Crop insurance covering losses from natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Claims paid based on crop cutting experiments.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Government pays remaining premium.
howToApply: Through bank (if crop loan taken) or online at pmfby.gov.in. Enroll before cut-off date (July for Kharif, December for Rabi).
coverage: Covers sowing failure, standing crop damage, post-harvest losses (14 days), and localized calamities.

benefit: Short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% interest (with prompt repayment subvention). Also covers animal husbandry and fisheries.
eligibility: All farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and SHGs. Based on land holding and crop pattern.
howToApply: Apply at any commercial bank, cooperative bank, or Regional Rural Bank. Documents: land records, identity proof, passport photo.
coverage: Includes crop production needs, post-harvest expenses, farm asset maintenance, and consumption needs.

benefit: Free soil testing and printed Soil Health Card with crop-specific fertilizer recommendations. Tests 12 parameters.
eligibility: All farmers. Testing done every 2 years through designated soil testing labs.
howToApply: Contact local agriculture office or submit soil samples at nearest Soil Testing Laboratory. Card available at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
coverage: Tests: pH, EC, organic carbon, N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B. Includes fertilizer dose recommendations.

scheme: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana) - Per Drop More Crop
benefit: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for others on micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler).
eligibility: All farmers with own/leased land. Priority to water-scarce areas and drought-prone blocks.
howToApply: Apply through state agriculture department portal or district horticulture office. Submit: land documents, Aadhaar, bank details.
coverage: Covers drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, raingun, and micro-sprinklers. Subsidy directly to farmer account after installation verification.

benefit: Online trading platform connecting APMC mandis across India. Farmers can sell produce to highest bidder nationwide.
eligibility: All farmers can sell through registered APMC mandis. Traders/buyers register on enam.gov.in.
howToApply: Register at nearest e-NAM enabled mandi with Aadhaar and bank account. Use mobile app for price discovery.
coverage: 1000+ mandis connected. Transparent bidding. Direct payment to farmer bank account. Quality assaying at mandi.
